recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: stubborn makers shipping anyway despite the noise
whispers inside the labs about slowing the machines
autumn night over the bay, mostly clear at fourteen degrees
september wind at seventeen kilometers per hour
hidden compute humming in distant mountain bunkers

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Catch autumn leaves blown across a foggy bay pier before they dissolve into mist — each leaf is a half-formed idea you launch toward shore before the wind steals it.
composer-2.5-fast.mechanic: flick leaves toward launch slots before they drift off-screen
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: each shipped leaf lands with a soft thud — one tiny commit in a quiet week
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: wind speed rises, leaves multiply, fog thickens and shrinks the safe zone
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: watercolor fog with muted rust and slate autumn palette

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: You're a cooling valve in an overheating AI lab — tap heat bursts in rhythm before processors hit redline, buying the machines one more breath.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.mechanic: rhythm tap on shrinking timing windows
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: each cooled cycle exhales steam and drops the temperature bar satisfyingly
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: beat patterns densify, decoy hotspots flash, cooldown windows shrink
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: neon wireframe server racks pulsing in the dark

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: One-thumb surgical edits on a living blueprint — trace cut lines to trim bloat from a schematic before a sunrise shipping deadline.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.mechanic: draw paths to slice away noise blocks from a shifting diagram
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: each clean slice removes clutter and reveals a sharper core shape
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: schematic complexity grows, decoy nodes appear, deadline bar drains faster
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: paper blueprint with ink bleeds and pencil smudges

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Sort glowing data shards into correct server racks inside a mountain bunker while tremors shuffle the lanes beneath your thumb.
gemini-3.1-pro.mechanic: lane switch and sort shards into matching rack colors
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: perfect sorts cascade with mechanical clunks and rack lights blink green
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: lanes multiply, shard colors blend, earthquake shuffles accelerate
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: lo-fi pixel bunker with amber CRT glow and concrete walls
